app.stopDaemonHint: Stops the whole daemon: all audio stops and the virtual devices go away
app.changedElsewhere: The graph was changed elsewhere. Apply to overwrite it, or Revert to load it.
app.noProvider: This system has no virtual audio devices yet: a “Virtual microphone” or “Virtual speakers” block stays silent{error}. Send to a playback device instead, or install the USB/IP client.
app.emptyHint: Add an Input and an Output from the left, link them, then press Apply.
category.trigger.hint: Fires an action when something happens
kind.virtual_mic.hint: A microphone other programs can pick
kind.virtual_speaker.hint: An output other programs can play into; you get what they play
kind.mixer.hint: Adds sounds together: add inputs with +, or link several sounds to one input
kind.gate.hint: Lets the sound through only while its condition is true
kind.level.hint: True while the sound is loud enough
kind.hotkey.hint: An action each time the keys are pressed
node.nameHint: Name of this block (free text: write what you like)
node.summed: Several links on this input: they are added together
kind.branch.hint: Sends the sound out of the first condition that is true, or out of “else”. The + adds an “else if”.
kind.select.hint: Takes the sound of the first condition that is true, or the “else” sound. The + adds an “else if”.
kind.delay.hint: Delays the sound, for example to line it up with another source
kind.all.hint: True while every linked condition is true: add inputs with +, or link several conditions to one input
kind.any.hint: True while at least one linked condition is true: add inputs with +, or link several conditions to one input
kind.hold.hint: Stays true for a while after the condition stops
kind.after.hint: Becomes true once the condition has been true for a while, and false as soon as it is
kind.change.hint: Sends an action when a condition becomes true, and another when it becomes false
app.cleanDevicesHint: Windows keeps a record of every old name of a virtual microphone or speaker. No old device to remove.
app.cleanCancelled: Cleaning cancelled: administrator rights were refused, nothing was removed
